input.quote: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 12.1 grants only Customer (Bluefly) a "revocable" licence to the Base Components; it names neither Affiliates nor contractors acting on our behalf, and Section 14.17 confirms no other licences are implied, so there is no path to add them. A licence revocable at IBM's discretion with affiliates and contractors excluded is walk-away territory and also fails the fallback (no affiliate coverage even on written notice). Successor transferability is already satisfied by Section 14.10, which lets Customer assign the Agreement to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition, so we have not touched it. The redline extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, deletes "revocable", and adds perpetuity/irrevocability for paid-up licences with breach-only termination for subscription licences.

mappings.element: The licence extends to Customer's affiliates.
The licence extends to contractors acting on Customer's behalf.
A subscription licence is terminable only for uncured material breach.
The licence is transferable to Customer's successors.
mappings.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.

proposal.summary: Extend the Base Components licence to Affiliates and contractors and remove at-will revocability
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Base Components licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, deleted the at-will "revocable" qualifier, and confirmed that a paid-up licence is perpetual and irrevocable while a subscription licence may be terminated only for our uncured material breach. Successor transfer is already addressed in Section 14.10.

ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a nonexclusive license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services

ops.text: A license under this Section 12.1 for which Customer has paid in full is perpetual and irrevocable, and any subscription license granted hereunder may be terminated by IBM only for Customer's material breach that remains uncured.
